title: ML-KEM / encapDecap / FIPS203 — ACVP test vector response (vector-set object)
$comment: Pinned transcription of draft-celi-acvp-ml-kem at usnistgov/ACVP commit bccef3648f6c05b224a051188ffe66f447cfdb6d: src/ml-kem/sections/07-responses.adoc [[response_table]] + [[response_group_table]] and 07-ml-kem-encapdecap-responses.adoc [[ML-KEM_encapDecap_vs_tr_table]] (c only for encapsulation, k for encapsulation/decapsulation, testPassed only for the key checks). acvVersion lives in the [{acvVersion},{…}] envelope element, not in this object. Which ONE of c/k/testPassed a given test carries depends on its group's function, which is not part of the response — response.ts enforces that per group; this schema pins the permitted field set.
